settings.title: Cut
settings.text: How well the stone returns light. Cut does more for how a diamond looks than anything else on the report.

settings.title: Color
settings.text: Graded from colorless downward. The difference between neighbouring grades is subtle once a stone is set.

settings.title: Clarity
settings.text: The natural inclusions a stone formed with. Many are invisible without magnification.

settings.title: Carat
settings.text: Weight, not size. Two stones of equal carat can look different depending on how they are cut.

settings.heading: What the grades actually mean
settings.text: Enough to shop with confidence, without a lecture. Ask us if you want to go deeper on any of them.
